title: A/P: a vendor credit used later still shows on the earlier date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has a $35.00 vendor credit created on day C.
  • It was used in full on a bill payment on day U, later than C (both past days).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to a day between C and U.
  4. Open every bucket.
  5. Look for the vendor credit.
  6. Set the date chip to day U.
  7. Open every bucket.
  8. Look for the vendor credit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the vendor credit is listed at $-35.00.

Step 8:

  • it is not listed.

Why this matters: Vendor credits are counted as they stood on the chosen day.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:171-204. V1 code, quoted: `(vc.date_spent IS NULL OR vc.date_spent > :asOfDate)`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-028) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
